name: Tanglewalker — a condition the board cannot read stays in the words of the trait
notes: Conor's decision 2026-10-13: rules about attacking, blocking and being targeted are traits (never ability lines), in the words of the card with the players filled in; Goaded is a trait only and names the player who goaded. Parser block 'Rules about attacking, blocking and being targeted' in cards-parser.js, _resolveTraitText in engine-helpers.js. "Each creature you control can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an artifact land." The trailing "as long as" was dropped when unreadable; for these rules it is kept, so the trait is qualified, not flat.

traits: Can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an artifact land
